quotes.text: NCT: NCT00239681 | TITLE: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo Controlled, Multicenter, Phase 3 Study of Rosuvastatin (CRESTOR®) 20 mg in the Prevention of Cardiovascular Events Among Subjects With Low Levels of Low Density Lipoprotein(LDL) Cholesterol & Elevated Levels of C-Reactive Protein

facts.note: The identifier appears only in the JUPITER registry record carried in the review packet; the publication itself (an exploratory age-subgroup analysis of JUPITER) states no registration number.

quotes.text: DESIGN: Secondary analysis of JUPITER (Justification for the Use of statins in Prevention: an Intervention Trial Evaluating Rosuvastatin), a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
DESIGN: allocation RANDOMIZED | model PARALLEL | masking QUADRUPLE | who masked PARTICIPANT, CARE_PROVIDER, INVESTIGATOR, OUTCOMES_ASSESSOR

facts.note: This report is an exploratory secondary (age >=70 subgroup) analysis of a parallel-group RCT, with the age cut-point chosen after trial completion.

quotes.text: PARTICIPANTS: Among the 17 802 participants randomly assigned with low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol levels less than 3.37 mmol/L (<130 mg/dL) and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein levels of 2.0 mg/L or more without cardiovascular disease, 5695 were 70 years or older.
The main eligibility criteria were age 50 years or older in men and 60 years or older in women, with no history of cardiovascular disease or diabetes

facts.note: The analysed participants were >=70 years and free of cardiovascular disease at randomization, but the trial's own entry criteria were men >=50 and women >=60; the >=70 group is a post hoc subgroup, not an entry criterion.

quotes.text: INTERVENTION: Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive 20 mg of rosuvastatin daily or placebo.
INTERVENTION: Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive 20 mg of rosuvastatin daily or placebo.

facts.note: Randomization was not stratified by age; the >=70 contrast is a subgroup of the randomized comparison.

quotes.text: Subjects who remained willing and eligible after the run-in phase were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either 20 mg rosuvastatin daily, or matching placebo.
